decision_rationale: The abstract and full text describe CARBON as a family of decoder-only autoregressive DNA language models trained for sequence modeling and generation. The model is also positioned as a genomic foundation model with pretraining on large annotation-aware corpora and broad downstream evaluations.
evidence_snippet: “efficient generative DNA language models”; “3B- and 8B-parameter decoder-only autoregressive models”; “genomic foundation models” and “pre-training corpus”
